title: Corrigendum to Circular no. SMDRP/POLICY/CIR-32/2000 dated July 27, 2000
text: SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT Mittal Court, A Wing, Gr. Floor, 224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMD/POLICY/CIR- 40 /2000 August 24, 2000 The President/Executive Director/ Managing Director of All the Stock Exchanges Dear Sir, Corrigendum to Circular no. SMDRP/POLICY/CIR-32/2000 dated July 27, 2000. Please refer to our above said circular regarding Modified Carry Forward System (MCFS). It is hereby informed that the second para under the heading "Incremental Carry Forward Margin (ICFM)" should read as under : - Accordingly, in case the carry forward position in any exchange, in any scrip, exceeds the parameters mentioned below, the ICFM shall be levied, in addition to the carry forward margin, at a rate which is higher of the rates determined as per the tables below : It may be noted that the other provisions of the said circular remain the same. Yours faithfully, P.K.BINDLISH DIVISION CHIEF Net Outstanding Market Position (Rs. In crores) Rate of Margin Carry Forward Net Position (in number of shares as % of total number of shares paid- up) Rate of Margin Exceeding 75 and up to 100 5% Exceeding 3% going upto 4% 5% Exceeding 100 and up to 150 8% Exceeding 4% going upto 5% 8% Exceeding 150 and up to 200 12% Exceeding 5% going upto 6% 12% Exceeding 200 and up to 300 17% Exceeding 6% going upto 7% 17% Exceeding 300 and up to 400 23% Exceeding 7% going upto 8% 23% Exceeding 400 30% Exceeding 8% 30% -- 1 of 2 -- SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT E-Mail : pkb@sebi.gov.in -- 2 of 2 --
